column1: # Source: https://www.discogs.com/help/creditslist (every credit role Discogs lists), read 2026-11-13 from the Internet Archive's copy of 2025-12-02, because the page itself refuses automated fetches. One role per line, in the page's order: its heading, a tab, the role as Discogs states it. A role the page lists under no heading is under Unlinked; the page's one lowercase `instruments` heading is written Instruments here.
